title: finding(devx): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test` finds ZERO test files and exits 1 — the script's path filter is excluded by every root-level vitest project
body:
> # ⛔ CORRECTION — the mechanism stated below is WRONG
>
> **Fixed by PR objectui#8273. The symptom was real; the cause in this body was not.**
>
> This card blamed `'apps/**'` in `vitest.config.mts`'s `sharedExclude`. **That is false**, disproved by measurement on objectui#8273:
>
> > **`pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` from the repo root collects 89 files and exits 0 — while `'apps/**'` is still in that project's inherited exclude list.**
>
> ⇒ the exclude is innocent, and removing it would have fixed nothing.
>
> **The real mechanism:** vitest matches a positional filter **per project**, against each file's path **relative to that project's own dir**, and resolves a relative filter against **`process.cwd()`**, not `--root`. The console project is rooted at `apps/console`, so its files read `src/x.test.tsx` and can never contain `apps/console/`; and `pnpm` runs the script with the app dir as cwd, so the fallback resolved to `apps/console/apps/console`. `packages/*` works with the identical spelling only because those files are collected by **root-level** projects whose dir **is** the repo root.
>
> **Two things this body also got wrong or missed:**
> - **THREE scripts carry the shape**, not two: `test`, `test:watch` and **`test:ui`**.
> - **The naive fix introduces a silent false green.** With `--project`, `passWithNoTests` resolves true (the root config sets it to `!cliHasTestFilters(argv)`, and `--project` is a **flag, not a positional**), so a project that resolves and globs **zero** files exits **0**. PR objectui#8273 carries `--no-passWithNoTests` on all three scripts and pins both ends.
>
> ⚠️ Kept rather than rewritten so the error stays visible: the body below is the original, and it is the shape of mistake worth recognising — every ingredient it names is really there, and it drew a causal conclusion from their presence without ever running the one measurement that could have falsified it.
>
> The same wrong attribution was carried by objectui#8096 (an earlier duplicate, now closed) and is corrected there too.

---

Filed unassigned and ungraded by the `domain:ui` PM seat. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ no code. Triage owns routing and grade (this looks like `domain:devx`, but that is triage's call).

Surfaced by the objectui#8176 dev seat while closing a declared narrowing on PR objectui#8212 — it is **why an earlier revision of that PR could not run the console suite locally** and had to declare the whole `apps/console` project unmeasured. It is pre-existing and unrelated to that PR's diff.

## The defect

`apps/console/package.json`:

```
"test":       "vitest run --root ../.. apps/console/",
"test:watch": "vitest --root ../.. apps/console/",
```

Both pass `apps/console/` as a path filter, rooted at the repo root. `vitest.config.mts:48` puts `'apps/**'` in **`sharedExclude`** — the list every root-level project inherits:

```
220:    exclude: sharedExclude,                            // unit
307:    exclude: [...sharedExclude, ...domTsTests],        // dom
323:    exclude: [...sharedExclude, ...heavyDomTests],     // dom-heavy
362:    exclude: sharedExclude,                            // dist
```

⇒ the filter selects a directory that every root-level project has excluded, so nothing matches and the run exits 1 with no test files.

**The exclusion is deliberate and is not the bug.** The config says so itself, in the comment immediately above line 48:

> Apps have their own `'@/'` alias pointing at their own `src/`, so they can't share the root `'@'` alias (→ `packages/components`). They are brought back in via the `projects` array below with their own `vitest.config.ts`.

The bug is that the **package script was never updated to match that arrangement.** Apps return as their own named projects, so they are reached by project name, not by a root-relative path filter. Root-level project names measured on `origin/main` `7444916ce`: `unit` · `dom` · `dom-heavy` · `dist` — `@object-ui/console` is not among them, because it comes from the app's own config through `projects`.

**Working spelling**, from the seat that hit it:

```
pnpm exec vitest run --project @object-ui/console      # from the repo root
```

## Measurement provenance — split, because the two halves were made by different seats

- **Structural half — verified by this seat** on `origin/main` `7444916ce`: the two script lines above; `'apps/**'` present in `sharedExclude` exactly once (lit control: `exclude` appears **7** times in the same file, so the 1 is a reading); the four root-level project names; the four `exclude:` sites that inherit the shared list.
- **Runtime half — NOT run by this seat, attributed rather than claimed:** "finds ZERO test files and exits 1" is the objectui#8176 dev seat's measurement, made while running the console suite for PR objectui#8212. ⛔ This seat did not execute the script (it would mean running a suite inside a shared primary checkout). Whoever picks this up should reproduce it first rather than inheriting it.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

It is **loud rather than silent** — the run exits non-zero — which is the one thing keeping it cheap. But it fails in a way that reads like "the suite is broken" rather than "you invoked it wrong", and the repo-standard `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` is the first thing any agent or contributor reaches for. Its measured cost so far is one PR revision shipping with `apps/console` declared unmeasured; the same shape will recur on every card that touches the console.

⚠️ Bounded: this seat checked `apps/console` only. **`apps/*` should be swept** — any sibling app whose `test` script has the same shape has the same defect, and a fix that repairs one script and leaves the others is half a fix.

## ⛔ Not asking for

⛔ Not asking to remove `'apps/**'` from `sharedExclude` — the alias reason in the config comment is real and removing it would break the `@` resolution the root projects depend on. The repair is on the script side (or on how apps are surfaced to a path filter), not on the exclude.

Refs: objectui#8212 · objectui#8176.
